'''Luzitall''' was a [[Water Complex]] obstacle used on a [[swoopchasing]] course. A five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]]-long channel, the [[Complex]] featured an array of increasingly difficult hairpins, turns, and curves. [[Repulsor buoy]]s were spaced along the course, and [[swoopchaser]]s raced through a series of [[Water/Legends|water]] jets that sprayed them as they passed. Below the racers, the water was churned by a series of [[Turbine/Legends|turbines]] and water generator to add another level of difficulty.<ref name="BSS" />
